author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv dual-expert (task-aware pooling, pre-norm=OFF, clip=1.0) — seed=42
abstract: Ablation to recover ncRNA on seed=42: task-aware pooling with mean_max_mix for ncRNA, mean_lse_mix otherwise; pre-fusion LN disabled; grad-clip=1.0.
